summary: Currenc Group Inc., a Singapore-based Nasdaq-listed foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a secured convertible bridge loan agreement dated September 20, 2026 with Apex Innovation Global Limited as lender and Alexander King Ong Kong as guarantor. Apex will advance US$1,500,000 in a single draw, bearing 1% interest, maturing the earlier of 18 months after drawdown or completion of the proposed Animoca Brands acquisition. Conversion is at Apex's option at the lower of US$2.85 or 85% of the lowest future fundraising price, floor US$3.19, capped at 19.99% of shares outstanding. Security is a first-ranking mortgage over 1,000,000 shares with 166.67% collateral coverage, subordinated to Moca Services debt. This is a routine financing disclosure, not a special situation; watch dilution and collateral top-up risk.
